name: sc-follow-blocks-turn
description: Strategy-card follows hold the turn (rules; user report: 'following Leadership doesn't block, the game just says my turn'). pbd28 r1: Mahact (Bot Gamma, a bot seat) plays Leadership; Yssaril and Naaz decline at once (bots), Deepwrought (mapclicker, the human seat) has not answered.
